heroSub.text: {business} finds out whether a repair makes sense or whether the tank is at the end of its life.

services.blurb: No hot water, strange noises, or a leaking tank: we repair or replace it.
services.directAnswer: {business} services and replaces water heaters across {areas}. Tank water heaters often last 8 to 12 years, and hard water can shorten that. We diagnose the problem, tell you plainly whether a repair or replacement makes sense, and install to code. A leaking tank should be shut off and replaced. Call {phone}.
process: Diagnose heating element, thermostat, burner, or leak
Explain repair or replacement with the cost picture
Install to code with correct venting and shutoffs
Test and show you the shutoff valves

faq.q: How long does a water heater last?
faq.a: Tank models commonly last 8 to 12 years. Sediment from hard water can shorten that. Age matters when choosing repair or replacement.

faq.q: Why does my water heater make popping sounds?
faq.a: Usually sediment on the bottom of the tank. Flushing it can help, and heavy buildup can signal the tank is aging.

faq.q: What should I do if the tank is leaking?
faq.a: Shut off the water supply to the heater and the power or gas, and call a plumber. A leak from the tank body generally means replacement.
